Godzilla has no server to install — it's a hosted platform you reach over the REST API, either directly or through an SDK.

Option A: Use an SDK

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk # or pip install godzilla-sdk}}

Full setup for each is in Node.js SDK and Python SDK.

Option B: Call the API directly

No install needed — every endpoint in the API reference is a plain HTTPS request.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Next|body_html=

Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API, for Go 1.21+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla/godzilla-go}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.go|language=go|code=import "github.com/godzilla/godzilla-go" client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create_pipeline.go|language=go|code=pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, godzilla.PipelineParams{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", })}}

Node.js SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A thin, typed wrapper around the v2 REST API for Node.js and TypeScript projects.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.ts|language=typescript|code=import { Godzilla } from "@godzilla/sdk"; const godzilla = new Godzilla({ apiKey: process.env.GODZILLA_API_KEY });}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

Listening for webhooks

The SDK includes a signature-verification helper for webhook payloads:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=verify.ts|language=typescript|code=import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk"; const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Retries are built in|body_html=

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.

}}
